question: Which Indian Squash player won the girls under 15 title at the prestigious British Junior Open in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **Anahat Singh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anahat Singh:-**

 
 
• **Anahat Singh is an Indian squash player who was born on March 13, 2008. **
 
• She is the top-ranked player in Asia in the Girls U17 category.
 
• At the age of 14, she was the youngest athlete to represent India at the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• Anahat started playing badminton when she was six years old, but she switched to squash at the age of eight.
 
• **She quickly rose through the ranks of junior squash, and in 2019, she won the under-11 girls' category gold medal at the prestigious British Open squash tournament, a first-ever for India.**
 
• She also won a bronze at the Asian junior championships later that year.
 
• **She won the girls under 15 title at the prestigious British Junior Open in January 2023,**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Tanvi Khanna:-**

 
 
• **She is an Indian female professional squash player and is a regular member of the Indian squash team. **
 
• She is currently ranked 69 in International rankings and is regarded as one of the finest squash players to have emerged from India.
 
• She was ranked as women's no.1 squash player in September 2023.
 
 
 
• **Neha Singh:-**
 
 
• **She is a young Indian professional squash player. **
 
• She is currently ranked 73 in the world by the Professional Squash Association (PSA).
 
• She is the highest ranked Indian female squash player after Tanvi Khanna.
